notes.title: Nimbus Update Released
notes.content:
Updates to Nimbus have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

Nimbus
  • Support for ghosts. The game will save ghost for the best times acquired on levels, hitting G will enable / disable the ghost feature.
  • A new Christmas themed world with new levels can be found by going right at the beginning of world 3.
  • A new Laser entity, present on the Christmas world.
  • Global Average leader board, where the players average time across all levels is ranked globally.
  • The soundtracks for the old worlds have been expanded, and the Christmas world features it's own selection of new tracks.
  • Better support for analog sticks when playing with a controller, making use of the higher resolution.
